gap:logistic_optimization.statement: Need to fit logistic regression with specific SGD-like constraints and evaluate L2 regularization, interaction terms, and compression trade-offs

hyp:l2_improves_brier.statement: L2 regularization will improve Brier score compared to baseline (lambda=0) by reducing overfitting

claim:l2_optimal_at_01.statement: L2 regularization strength lambda=0.1 minimizes 5-fold cross-validated Brier score (0.207077), improving baseline (lambda=0) by 0.0089

claim:interactions_significant.statement: Interaction features (x0*x1, x1*x2, x2*x3, x0*x3) significantly improve model: paired t-test t=4.374 > 2.0, indicating interaction terms reduce Brier score across all 5 folds

claim:compression_sparsity20_bits4.statement: Model compression with 20% sparsity and 4-bit quantization achieves highest retention (0.9992) of dense model performance, maintaining Brier score near 0.1419
